questions.title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
questions.background: Alibaba's 2014 US initial public offering raised $25 billion, setting the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign company.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins. Accepted Answer Format : The company's commonly used name.
questions.current_reasoning: A severe July 2 semiconductor sell-off completely erased SK Hynix's valuation cushion above Alibaba's $25.0B record right before July 6 bookbuilding and July 9 pricing. Following reports that Meta may lease surplus AI compute capacity and Apple is in chip supply talks with two Chinese memory makers, KOSPI plunged 7.89% (triggering a sell-side sidecar) and SK Hynix tumbled 14.57% to close at 2,187,000 KRW amid a 10th consecutive day of net foreign selling (5.46T won), while the won weakened to 1,555.8/USD. At that close, SK Hynix's entire board-authorized maximum of 17.79 million new shares equals 38.91T KRW, or $25.01B at a 0% ADR discount—leaving zero buffer above Alibaba's $25B mark. Worse, after Seoul closed on July 2, the US semiconductor index fell another 5.4% (SanDisk -14.1%, Nvidia -1.4%), creating immediate gap-down pressure for Friday July 3 KOSPI trading (while US markets are closed for the July 3 holiday). Because ADR pricing is tied to the last KOSPI close and typically requires a 3-8% institutional discount to clear a $25B block, SK Hynix now likely needs a ~6-12% rally over July 3-9 to clear $25B, while the ~25% drawdown from its June 25 peak (2.90M KRW) also elevates postponement/downsizing risk past July 10. Still, Kiwoom Securities analysts note the July 10 ADR schedule remains intact and flag Samsung Electronics' July 7 preliminary Q2 earnings (after Korea's June chip exports surged +199.5% YoY) as a potential sharp rebound catalyst given ~15% 5-day volatility. Reversing sharply from SK Hynix 0.77 / Alibaba 0.23 to Alibaba 0.62 / SK Hynix 0.38.

local_articles.title: Will SK hynix's Nasdaq debut save troubled won?
local_articles.snippet: South Korean chipmaker SK hynix's planned listing of American depositary receipts in the US could strengthen the ailing Korean won, which recently slid to its weakest level in 17 years against the dollar, providing a rare source of dollar inflows. The chipmaker plans to list its ADRs on the Nasdaq on July 10, aiming to raise as much as $30 billion in what would rank among the largest overseas equity offerings by a South Korean company. If a substantial portion of the dollar proceeds is repatriated to finance domestic chip investments, the inflows could help ease the pressure on the won by increasing the supply of dollars in the local foreign exchange market. The won has remained under pressure this year amid sustained capital outflows, struggling to strengthen beyond 1,500 won per US dollar. questions.title: Which ownership group will receive NFL owners' approval to buy the Seattle Seahawks in 2026?
questions.background: The Seattle Seahawks are owned by Paul Allen's estate. Allen's will calls for the team to be sold and the assets distributed to charities.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official NFL announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the purchasing group approved by NFL owners. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the purchasing ownership group in the first sale of the Seattle Seahawks formally approved by NFL owners during 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.
questions.current_reasoning: June 29 Seattle Times coverage citing Bloomberg News reports that first-round bids to buy the Seattle Seahawks were due Monday, June 29 (earlier than previously rumored July 6), that no new potential buyers have emerged beyond the three previously identified groups (Aditya Mittal & Wyc Grousbeck, Todd Boehly, and Vinod Khosla), and that the bidder pool is 'fairly shallow' and 'shrinking' as the record $9B-$10B valuation tests billionaires' cash appetite. Confirming a shallow pool with no newly reported suitors on bid-deadline day concentrates probability mass onto the three active groups (Mittal/Grousbeck 0.30, Boehly 0.25, Khosla 0.23; combined 0.78, up from 0.66), while trimming unmentioned names Apostolopoulos (0.04), Bezos (0.03), and the unannounced mystery-bidder tail (from 23% to 15%).

questions.title: Which Federal Reserve policymakers will vote for an interest-rate increase at the July 29, 2026 FOMC meeting?
questions.background: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets US monetary policy. Its policy announcements disclose members' votes and the policy preferences of dissenting voters.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Federal Reserve's official policy statement and voting record for the meeting concluding July 29, 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution : Identify every voting member whose recorded position favors increasing the federal funds target range relative to the range immediately before the meeting. Include those members whether an increase is adopted or they dissent in favor of one. Accepted Answer Format : All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.
questions.current_reasoning: On June 25, May PCE matched consensus at three-year highs (headline 4.1% YoY / +0.4% MoM; core 3.4% YoY / +0.3% MoM, highest since Oct 2023), while personal income (+0.7%), spending (+0.7%), and an upward Q1 GDP revision (+0.5pp to 2.1%) ran hotter than expected. CME FedWatch priced ~70% odds of a July 29 hold (~30% odds of a July hike) and 62%-68% odds of a September hike, though Brent crude falling back to pre-Iran-war $72-$73/bbl preserves a strong case for waiting until September. With higher July majority-hike mass (~25%) and hotter core/demand data lowering solo-dissenter odds ('Hammack' trimmed to 9% and solo 'Logan' replaced by 'Bowman, Hammack, Logan' at 5% given Bowman's hawkish dissent record and Kashkari's higher sensitivity to falling oil), multi-hawk dissent sets led by the April dissenting trio 'Hammack, Kashkari, Logan' (15%), 'Hammack, Logan' (14%), and 'Bowman, Hammack, Kashkari, Logan' (6%) top the distribution, leaving 51% across unanimous hold, majority-hike combinations, and other subsets.

local_articles.title: Fed's Beth Hammack Warns AI Spending Could Keep Inflation Hot and Force Interest Rates Higher: 'Not Seein
local_articles.snippet: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said Tuesday that surging demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure could add to inflationary pressures and may force the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again if price growth remains elevated. Speaking to CNBC from the European Central Bank conference in Sintra, Portugal, Hammack said inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target and warned that persistent price pressures tied to AI spending could complicate monetary policy. "We’ve got inflation that’s too high, and it’s been too high for the past five years," Hammack told CNBC’s Sara Eisen. "When I look at policy, if that continues, it may mean that we need higher interest rates to bring inflation back down to target”. The Federal Reserve uses interest rates to manage inflation. Higher rates generally slow borrowing and spending, helping cool price growth across the economy

questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team he chooses.
questions.current_reasoning: Sharp July 1 repricing across liquid prediction markets ($23M+ Kalshi, $4.7M Polymarket) and NBA free-agency moves narrows the race into a virtual dead heat between Golden State and Cleveland. After peaking at 50-58% on June 30, the Golden State Warriors pulled back to 38% (earlier) / 31% (later SI snapshot) on Kalshi, 34% on Polymarket, and +100 on BetOnline amid cap complexity from Kristaps Porzingis's $40M/2yr re-signing, an aging West roster, and Washington resisting a Jimmy Butler-for-Anthony Davis trade—cutting GSW from 0.49 to 0.36. Conversely, the Cleveland Cavaliers surged from 0.15 to 0.35 (jumping to 34-38% on Kalshi, 33% on Polymarket, and -150 favorite on BetOnline, partly fueled by viral hometown-reunion buzz we discount slightly alongside ESPN's Ben Golliver citing an East executive calling Cleveland 'the cleanest fit' after their ECF run). The Miami Heat drop from 0.25 to 0.18 (18% Kalshi, 21% Polymarket, 5/1 BetOnline) after spending $6.5M of their NTMLE on Tim Hardaway Jr. and facing Giannis Antetokounmpo stylistic-fit questions. The San Antonio Spurs are eliminated from our top five (0.04 -> <0.01) after Marc Stein reported they are not pursuing James and San Antonio spent their NTMLE on Tobias Harris (2yr/$31M). On Klutch's 'Game Over' podcast July 1, Rich Paul said he spoke with 12-14 teams and market size won't matter if James can contend; confirmed July 1 outreach brings in the Denver Nuggets (0.035, Denver Post/Marc Stein, BetOnline cut 50/1 -> 25/1) and Minnesota Timberwolves (0.025, The Athletic, 2-3% Kalshi/Polymarket, 18/1 BetOnline), leaving 5.0% for the rest of the league (Knicks, Wizards, Thunder, etc.) ahead of the July 6 moratorium lift.

questions.title: Which UK university will be identified in nationwide reporting by the end of July 2026 as having investigated the most students for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025?
questions.background: Pro-Palestinian campus protests in Britain have prompted disputes over university disciplinary practices and freedom of expression.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Nationwide comparative reporting by Al Jazeera and Liberty Investigates, drawing on university Freedom of Information disclosures and available by July 31, 2026. Resolution Rule : Resolve to the university with the highest reported number of students subjected to disciplinary investigations for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025 among the universities covered. Investigations need not have resulted in sanctions. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the university.
questions.current_reasoning: Al Jazeera English and Liberty Investigates already launched their 2026 FOI series (to >150 UK universities) in April 2026; in Liberty Investigates' earlier Feb 2025 FOI dataset covering Oct 2023-Aug 2024, University College London led all known UK institutions with 12 students investigated (ahead of Cardiff with 9 by April 2025, King's College London with 7, and LSE with at least 7). UCL also has one of the UK's largest student bodies and a proven track record of disclosing exact student counts rather than redacting under personal-data exemptions. Extending the window through Nov 2025 brings large protest-heavy campuses like Manchester and Oxford (both featured in the April 2026 Al Jazeera/Liberty Investigates Horus surveillance disclosures) into contention, while 40% mass remains across the broad field of other UK universities (SOAS, LSE, Edinburgh, Cambridge, Sheffield, Queen Mary, Leeds, Warwick, Bristol, etc.).

questions.title: Who will win stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France?
questions.background: The Tour de France awards individual stage victories separately from the overall race title.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The race organizer’s official stage 11 classification, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable sports reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the rider officially classified as the winner of stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France, including any penalties applied when the stage results are confirmed. Accepted Answer Format : The winning rider’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Stage 11 (July 15, Vichy to Nevers, 161.3km) is officially categorized by ASO as a flat, obstacle-free sprint stage ending on a wide descending boulevard, with only two minor Cat 4 climbs. Cyclist's June 24 startlist preview ranks Tim Merlier (5-star) as the top pure sprinter ahead of Jasper Philipsen (4-star), Olav Kooij (4-star, pending final Decathlon-CMA CGM selection), Biniam Girmay (3-star), and Jordi Meeus (3-star), while Lidl-Trek brings Mads Pedersen rather than Jonathan Milan. Because Stage 11 falls in week two right after a hard Stage 10 on exposed roads with crash, abandon, crosswind, and breakaway risk, top-5 sprinters account for ~58% combined.

local_articles.title: Former Tour de France champion Froome calls time on career
local_articles.snippet: July 3 - Four-time Tour de France champion Chris Froome has retired from professional cycling, bringing the curtain down on a glittering career spanning over two decades in the sport. Froome confirmed his retirement ahead of this year's Tour de France, which begins on July 4 and concludes in Paris on July 26. The 41-year-old has not raced since sustaining life-threatening injuries in a training crash last year in France. He was airlifted to hospital in Toulon after suffering broken ribs, a collapsed lung and a back fracture. "Unfortunately, there was that fall last summer," Froome was quoted as saying by The Athletic on Thursday. "That wasn’t the way I wanted it to end. But even then, I knew it was over." local_articles.title: Pogacar is undeniable favourite, says Tour de France director
local_articles.snippet: BARCELONA, July 3 - Slovenia's Tadej Pogacar is the "undeniable favourite" for this year's Tour de France, which begins in Barcelona on Saturday, according to Tour director Christian Prudhomme. "He is the undeniable favourite, without a doubt," Prudhomme told reporters on Friday, a day before the first-stage team time trial. The Slovenian, twice defending champion, is bidding for a record-equalling fifth Tour de France to join greats Jacques Anquetil, Bernard Hinault, Eddy Merckx and Miguel Indurain. Pogacar's main rival will once again be Denmark's Jonas Vingegaard. "Jonas Vingegaard has regained all his abilities, he had certainly lost some after his horrific crash in the Tour of the Basque Country (in 2024)," Prudhomme said.
